Operate on lifecycle-preliminary objects parked under .zqk/object_drafts/

(not visible to object list/count). Subcommands: sweep (delete drafts),

promote (materialize to CAS) — see CAS create membrane docs.

  Dry-run sweep all draft-plane objects
  zqk.test object draft sweep --dry-run --all
  Dry-run promote all draft-plane objects
  zqk.test object draft promote --dry-run --all
  Sweep draft backlog items older than 7d
  zqk.test object draft sweep --kind backlog_item --older-than 168h --all

Usage:
  zqk.test object draft [command]

Available Commands:
  promote     Promote (or dry-run) objects on the object draft plane
  sweep       Delete (or dry-run) objects on the object draft plane

Flags:
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)

Use "zqk.test object draft [command] --help" for more information about a command.
